observations: Sense trigger input successfully skipped the startup videos.
The flat-menu beam moved, but the highlighted menu item did not follow hover; only the already-highlighted option could be accepted reliably.
The post-load press-a-key prompt still required keyboard input.
Walking remained severely jerky. Producer collection averaged 9.731 ms with a 12.457 ms p95, dominated by CPU copy, which is larger than a 120 Hz frame budget at the upper samples.
The clip showed a visibly rolled horizon and the full player avatar moving in front of the HMD during physical crouch.
The user reported that the first shot terminated the game. The runtime emitted no fire_left/right=true gameplay-input record before exit, so the exact failing call is not proven by telemetry.
The process nevertheless reached normal outer run_end; inner presenter shutdown completion was not observed.
